title: 10 Second Shuriken
description:
10 Second Shuriken is a fps platformer. Speed run and master levels within 10 seconds destroying all the enemies to get the fastest time.Features

• A game where you only have 10 seconds to beat the level

• Jump and shoot your way through 40 levels taking you from grasslands, to laser and ice worlds.

• Slice enemies with your samurai sword

• Collect and use power ups like teleportation shurikens and jet packs to help you destroy your enemies

• A feeling of satisfaction when you kill all the enemies so fast that you get a 3 star rating

• Steam achievements

• Dodge Lasers, jump on trampolines, and destroy odd shaped enemies
description_short: 10 Second Shuriken is a fps platformer. Speedrun your way through levels destroying all the enemies as quickly as you possibly can to get a legendary 3 star rating. JUMP your way through sky islands, enemy projectiles and lasers as you attempt this task in 10 SECONDS.
